form.name: Certification of Eligibility for Provisional License

title: Certification of Eligibility for Provisional License

header_fields.label: Applicant Full Name (Last, First, Middle, Suffix)

certification.text: By signing the above certification, I, the tutor, certify that the learner has received 40 hours of driving experience specified by me on the dates and times indicated.
certification.extra_text: I hereby certify that I am at least 16 years and 6 months old and have been a holder of a valid learner permit for at least six months, during which time I have not admitted to, been liable for or convicted of an offense for which points may be assessed. I also certify that I have received at least 40 hours of driving experience.  Applicant’s Signature ______  Date ______

unfillable: Tutor driver license number, state of issuance and expiration date (a photocopy of each tutor's license must be attached)
notes: One page: 11 rows after the printed Example row. The 'Amount of Time' column holds the clock times (the example shows '8:15 am – 10:15 am') and 'Hours/Minutes' the length.
Two tutor signature blocks are printed; each tutor certifies only the hours they supervised.
